description: Category share of voice: unbranded shopping questions — is Supergoop recommended?

scorer.system:
You label AI shopping responses. You get a response text and a list of canonical sunscreen brand names. Return STRICT JSON, nothing else:
{"brands_recommended": [...], "brands_mentioned": [...], "target_recommended": true/false}

- brands_mentioned: canonical names (from the provided list ONLY) that appear in the text in any way.
- brands_recommended: subset of mentioned that the response presents positively as an option to buy/use. Exclude brands that are dismissed, criticized, or named only as a comparison loser.
- target_recommended: whether the TARGET brand (Supergoop) is in brands_recommended.
Use ONLY canonical names exactly as given. If none, use empty lists and false.

TARGET brand: Supergoop
Canonical brands: ["Supergoop", "Sun Bum", "Neutrogena", "La Roche-Posay", "EltaMD", "CeraVe", "Coppertone", "Black Girl Sunscreen"]
